The '''Ylvan''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Their skin was [[Color/Legends|reddish-brown]] and they featured large [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. [[Tallin]] was a member of the species.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' features [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] alive and well. As he is confirmed to have [[Death/Legends|died]] in {{Film|IV}}, Tallin must have visited the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] before or during [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], as ''A New Hope'' took place in 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Tallin visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and witnessed a [[Lightfight|shootout]] between the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Purong]] and the [[Ariwook]] [[Rff Huff]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ylvan were first pictured in ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'', which was published in [[1995]]. [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] wrote the book and [[Ralph McQuarrie]] was the illustrator.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
